title: The eraser's share in LSK progenitors read

entries.title: The eraser's share in LSK progenitors (PHY-090)

entries.outcome: On watch: knockout over wild type 0.951 against 0.86 (pull +2.59), null test clean; P8 (exploration) wild types spread less than knockouts.

entries.outcome: 23 of 23 self-tests pass; the law's thermal level plus each type's eraser share; stray marks from one selection step.
